instructions.en: The following statements may apply more or less to you. To what extent do you think each statement applies to you personally?
instructions.zh: 以下陈述可能在不同程度上符合您的情况。您觉得每条陈述在多大程度上符合您本人？

administration.timeFrame: General beliefs; no fixed recall period
administration.estimateBasis: Authors estimated about30 seconds for original language; not Chinese timing validation.

items.en: If I work hard, I will succeed.
Whether at work or in my private life: What I do is mainly determined by others.
items.zh: 无论是在工作中还是在私人生活中，我做什么主要由别人决定。

items.en: Fate often gets in the way of my plans.
items.zh: 命运常常阻碍我的计划。

scoring.higherMeaning: Greater agreement with respective source-of-control beliefs, not better/worse ability or responsibility. Both dimensions may be endorsed at once.
scoring.precision: Retain half-point means; never round prior to reporting.

missingPolicy.rule: Each two-item subscale requires both valid1–5 integer answers. Any missing item means that subscale has no score. Platform complete report may require all4; never impute, substitute0, prorate or copy opposite score.
missingPolicy.source: Official documentation PDF p4. Authors population-analysis MI/FIML advice is not an individual-report imputation rule.

thresholdPolicy: No validated diagnostic or low/medium/high cutoff supplied. No invented Chinese norms, risk strata, percentiles or success prediction. External sample descriptive parameters are inactive reference dossier only.

sampleContext.sampling: Native-language adult online quota samples; not all adults nor Chinese/youth norms
sampleContext.invariance: Metric supported, scalar not supported across UK/DE. Does not establish comparable national means or English–Chinese equivalence.

reliability.limits: Only2 items per dimension, modest precision, self-report online adult validation. Research survey only; not individual diagnosis. Retest≥.64 summary is not universally correct: German external retest is.61. 2026 method-factor findings caution against asserting two uncontested independent traits.

scientificUseLimit: Authors recommend self-report research surveys with severe time constraints, not individual diagnostics. Reflective feedback is project-authored explanatory support, not a validated personal assessment or intervention.

reportPolicy.trigger: Same neutral explanatory report for all complete valid patterns; no score-based strata or unsupported individual inference.
reportPolicy.technicalDetails: Explain plain-language meaning first. Put formulas/references in detail area. No claim this pack has hidden platform score UI.

report.heading: 看看您怎样理解“事情由谁推动”
report.summary: 这4道题分别询问您怎么看自己的行动，以及他人、环境和机遇对结果的影响。它们不是一道非此即彼的选择题：一个人可以既愿意努力，也清楚很多条件不由自己决定。

perspectives.label: 自己的行动与结果
perspectives.description: 这一组关注您是否觉得自己的决定和努力能影响结果。它不测量实际能力，也不保证只要努力就一定成功。

perspectives.label: 外部力量与结果
perspectives.description: 这一组关注您是否觉得他人的决定、命运或机遇影响结果。承认限制不等于懒惰、推卸责任或失败；有些障碍确实需要支持和制度层面的改变。

report.everydayExample: 比如准备一次重要申请：整理材料是自己能着手的部分；名额、规则或他人的决定不完全由自己掌握。这只是帮助理解题意的例子，不是在推断您的经历。
reflection: 想到一件最近的事：哪些部分可以由自己行动，哪些需要别人协助，哪些暂时无法改变？
有没有把本来不属于自己的责任，也一并背在身上？
report.action: 如果愿意，可把一件小事写成三栏：“我能做的”“可以求助的”“暂时无法决定的”。只从第一栏选一个轻量步骤，也允许自己暂停或寻求帮助；这不是必须完成的训练。
report.limits: 中文目前是未经验证的研究工作译稿，仅供成人研究中的解释和反思，不提供诊断、能力判定、人格优劣或升学就业建议。两组内容分开描述，不合并排名，也不能用来认定成功或困境是谁的责任。
report.illustrationSuggestion: 可选原创三栏简图：能着手／可求助／暂不可决定；不画红绿风险区，不把外部限制画成缺陷。
